Pre-release draft · iOS and Android apps
Tokipin is a journaling app for iOS and Android that works without an account. Your records and drafts stay in the app\'s storage on your device.
The words, emoji, places and times you enter, with the record date and the order you entered them. This and any draft are used to keep writing offline and to find and edit records by date.
Does it access my location or calendar?
You type places yourself. Tokipin never asks for location or calendar access. The calendar in the app shows only your own records.
How are records kept and deleted?
You can find records in the calendar or search and delete one item or a whole day. Records stay until you delete them or clear the app data, which removes the records and drafts on that device.

You can export your records as a JSON file from Settings. Exported files remain after you delete records in the app, so manage them where you saved them. Tokipin has no account sync. Whether records are included in device backups depends on your system and backup settings.
Operator details, contact and effective date will be announced at launch.
These terms apply when you write and open personal records in the Tokipin app for iOS and Android.
Without an account you can leave words, emoji, places and times in any order, reopen and search them in the year, month, recorded days and day views, and edit or delete them yourself.
You own the records you create. When you share records containing other people\'s writing or personal information, respect their rights and privacy.
Changing devices or clearing app data
Tokipin does not sync records to an account. Before changing devices or clearing app data, export the records you want to keep from Settings.
